condition: recombinant WT shell expressed in E. coli; pH 3 disassembly followed by neutral-pH reassembly; stable incomplete assembly intermediate
notes: Stable incomplete WT shell assembly intermediate containing 48 Enc monomers. The particle retains an overall icosahedral-like geometry but has a single large opening caused by missing subunits on one side. Obtained after low-pH disassembly followed by neutral-pH reassembly.
shell_sequence_change: No engineered alteration of the WT shell protein is recorded for this assembly.
